_: Emma's recording of the niet/geen lesson (28 Nov 2026, raw/niet-geen/rec.wav, 2:42), cut per scene of the full lesson. Times are seconds in the recording, found with silencedetect (noise ~-72 dB, voice ~-22 dB). chunk = the part of the recording that plays in the scene, continuous (her own pauses stay); lead = seconds from the scene start to the chunk; tail = seconds after it. The other fields say when something appears, as a time in the recording: beats (story: when the beat starts, card = when the Dutch sentence comes), cols (split: each column and its negation), punch, rows (rule and trick rows). A quiz has answer: Emma reads it right when the answer drops in. Read by build_voice.py.
